summary.headline: A Milestone Week, Two Sweeps, and Steady Progress
body: It was a busy weekend across the country — Elizabeth King passed 25 college kills and helped UIC grind out a five-set win over Loyola, while Gracyn Sanders and Kylie Lambert both picked up sweeps for teams on winning streaks. A few other girls are still waiting for their first match reps, but everyone's staying in the mix.
Anna — Morehead State dropped both matches to Marshall this weekend (L 0-3, L 0-3), but Anna kept her spot starting at right side and has 16 kills and 10 blocks on the season.
Elizabeth — UIC lost to DePaul and Northern Illinois but bounced back to beat Loyola in five sets; she also crossed 25 career kills along the way.
Gracyn — Gardner-Webb swept both Southern Illinois and Austin Peay this weekend, and Gracyn's hitting .333 on the year with 10 kills in limited action.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech kept rolling with a sweep of Arkansas-Monticello and a four-set win over Southern Arkansas; Kylie's up to 121 assists and 35 digs running the offense.
Layla — Winona State lost to Wayne State and Augustana this week; Layla is still waiting for her first match action as a freshman.
Mary — Trevecca split the week, falling to Valdosta State but sweeping Auburn Montgomery; Mary hasn't gotten into a match yet this season.

spotlight.note: She hit a career milestone with her 25th college kill and helped UIC battle back for a five-set win over Loyola.

players.name: Anna Schiltz
players.blurb: Anna has been seeing steady court time this season, appearing in 10 matches and 28 sets so far while starting at right side. The Eagles hit a rough patch recently, dropping matches to Cincinnati, Michigan State, and Marshall (twice), but Anna has continued to contribute on both offense and defense, including some solid digging and blocking. Next up for Morehead State is the start of OVC play against Lindenwood on September 25-26.

players.name: Elizabeth King
players.blurb: Elizabeth has been seeing regular court time this season, appearing in 11 matches and 24 sets so far, with 30 kills and 11 total blocks to her name. The Flames have had a mixed but active stretch, picking up wins over Central Michigan, Western Michigan, and a five-set thriller against Loyola, while dropping matches to Auburn, Northern Illinois, and DePaul. UIC returns to Credit Union 1 Arena on September 25th for their next home match.

players.blurb: Gracyn has appeared in five matches and nine sets for Gardner-Webb, hitting .333 with 10 kills on 21 swings and adding three block assists. The Runnin' Bulldogs are 6-4 heading into Big South play.

players.name: Breanna Hard
players.blurb: Breanna has been getting steady court time this season, running the offense as a freshman setter with 55 assists, 22 digs, and an ace so far. She's shown she can handle the ball under pressure and is settling into her role on the roster. The Redhawks are back in action Wednesday, September 23, as the fall schedule continues.

players.name: Kylie Lambert
players.blurb: Kylie has been a steady presence running the offense as a freshman setter, playing in all 11 matches so far and racking up 121 assists along with 35 digs and 8 service aces. The Golden Suns have been rolling lately, winning three of their last four matches including sweeps and strong four-set wins over Henderson State, Southern Arkansas, and Arkansas-Monticello. Up next, the team has a break before returning to action in November, so keep an eye out for the next update on Kylie and the Suns.

players.blurb: Layla hasn't appeared in a match yet for Winona State. The Warriors are 2-6 and into NSIC play; she's practicing with the team and we'll note it the moment she gets on the floor.

players.blurb: Mary hasn't appeared in a match yet this season, but she's part of a Trevecca team that's been battling through a tough non-conference and early-conference stretch. The Trojans dropped a few matches at the Bash at the Beach tournament and to Valdosta State, but picked up a nice sweep at Auburn Montgomery to open Gulf South play. The team is back in action September 22 against UAH.

players.name: Peyton Strout
players.blurb: Peyton has gotten into one match so far this season, though she hasn't recorded a stat line yet. The Mavericks have been battling through a busy stretch of matches recently. We'll keep watching for more playing time for Peyton as the season moves forward.

players.name: Catherine Callahan
players.blurb: The Scots were on the road September 3 and fell 0-3 to Waubonsee Community College. We weren't able to pull up a game-by-game stat line for Catherine from the public game notes this week, so we can't say for certain how much court time she's getting right now, though she remains listed on the roster as a libero/defensive specialist. We'll keep checking for the next match update so you can see how she's doing.

players.name: Madison Mitchell
players.blurb: Madison hasn't appeared in a match yet this season, but she's part of a McHenry County College squad that's been busy on the court in tournament play. The Scots compete in the Illinois Skyway Collegiate Conference, and there's plenty of season still ahead for her to get into the lineup. We'll keep watching for her name to show up in the stats as the schedule continues.

players.name: Peyton Wurtz
players.blurb: Peyton got off to a strong start in her freshman season, leading the Spartans with 26 digs in a five-set win over Ellsworth Community College at the season-opening tournament in Rockford. That performance shows she's already earning real playing time at libero for Elgin. The team's next match is on the road at Lewis & Clark Community College.

buzz.title: A Big Volleyball Weekend Ahead
body: It's a packed few days for the girls, with Elizabeth playing three matches in three days, Gracyn opening a big tournament in Tennessee, and Anna facing Marshall twice as Morehead State tries to build on its recent win streak. A few of the girls are also opening conference play this weekend, so there's plenty to cheer for.
Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Fri 4 PM CT, then home vs Marshall Sat 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+; back-to-back games give the Eagles a shot to keep their momentum going after three straight wins.
Elizabeth — UIC at Loyola Thu 6 PM CT, at Northern Illinois Fri 6 PM CT, at DePaul Sat 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+; a busy road stretch right after her first career dig and block assist last week.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb opens a tournament in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Fri 12 PM CT, Southern Illinois Fri 3 PM CT, SIUE Sat 10 AM CT; three matches in two days as the Bulldogs head toward Big South play.
Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan hosts Assumption Sat 1 PM CT and Saint Michael's Sun 1 PM CT, both on FloSports; a chance for the Redhawks to pick up home wins.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thu 6 PM CT on the GAC Network, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Fri 4 PM CT; the Golden Suns are 1-0 in conference and looking to stay unbeaten.
Layla — Winona State at Wayne State Fri 6 PM CT and at Augustana Sat 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus; we'll be watching closely for her first minutes of the season.
Mary — Trevecca opens Gulf South play at Auburn-Montgomery Fri 5 PM CT, then at Valdosta State Sat 12 PM CT, both on FloSports; a fresh start as the Trojans dive into conference games.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Sat 10 AM CT; no stream listed, but a good chance for her to log more court time.

buzz.title: A Full Weekend of Matches Ahead
body: It's a busy few days for the group — Elizabeth is riding high after her first college milestones, Kylie opens conference play at home, and Anna gets two cracks at the same opponent. Several of the girls are also in multi-match road trips, so there's a lot to watch this weekend.
Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Friday 4 PM CT, then hosts Marshall Saturday 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+. A home-and-home gives the Eagles two chances to bounce back after last week's losses.

Elizabeth — UIC plays three straight Valley road matches: Loyola Thursday 6 PM CT, NIU Friday 6 PM CT, DePaul Saturday 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+. She just picked up her first college dig and block assist, so keep an eye on her stat line growing.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb plays three matches in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Friday noon CT, Southern Illinois Friday 3 PM CT, and SIUE Saturday 10 AM CT. The Runnin' Bulldogs have won four of their last six, so momentum is on their side.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thursday 6 PM CT on GAC Sports Network to open conference play, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Friday 4 PM CT. The Golden Suns start 1-0 in the GAC.
Layla — Winona State travels to Wayne State Friday 6 PM CT and Augustana Saturday 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus. The Warriors are still looking to build momentum in NSIC play.
Mary — Trevecca is on the road at Auburn-Montgomery Friday 5 PM CT and Valdosta State Saturday noon CT, both on FloSports. The Trojans are still chasing their first GSC win.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Community College Saturday 10 AM CT, her only match this weekend as she keeps working into the libero/DS rotation.
